description: Current perpetual futures funding rate for one coin on every exchange TradeHub supports, per interval and annualised, with the age of each reading. Use when choosing where to hold a long or a short, or to check a funding spread. Not a forecast: rates change every interval. Input: symbol (base coin). Rates are fractions; positive means longs pay shorts. Sorted by annualised rate, highest first; TradeHub takes no rebates from any exchange. Next: get_perp_contract_rules(venue, symbol) or size_position_by_risk.
name: compare_funding_rates_across_venues

age_seconds.description: How old this reading is, in seconds

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

funding_annualized.description: Rate scaled to a year, as a fraction

funding_rate.description: Rate per interval, as a fraction; positive: longs pay shorts

stale.description: True if older than 10 seconds; ranked last

cheapest_for_longs.description: Fresh venue with the lowest annualised rate (longs pay least / earn most)

cheapest_for_shorts.description: Fresh venue with the highest annualised rate (shorts earn most)

neutrality.description: Commercial relationships that could affect the order (none)
